models.title: Days of inventory on hand
models.summary: Days of inventory on hand divides the reporting-period duration by its corresponding turnover.

relationship.original_equation: Days of inventory on hand = period length / matching turnover
relationship.translation_notes: Period is a physical duration in days, not an annualization factor; output retains the same duration unit. Turnover is a dimensionless count over that period.
